observations: Every generated-id digest equals its current pin in all 144 measured legs; token counts exact everywhere.

Digest movement versus the b6d662a8 matrix is confined to the re-pinned BF16 legs that main's native-order dense BF16 decode GEMV and prefill restructure produced: fork BF16 long ad964232ee67fecd -> 8690dc83246b39f8, stock BF16 long c5be9207833d2a26 -> 46108ad71157cb4d, stock BF16 short f26175202f3dabe9 -> 7fc0f968789b1882 (stock now equals the native macOS short digest). All six Q4 digests, BF16 fork short and BF16 1K context are unchanged.
The three native-parity legs (Q4 short, Q4 1K, BF16 1K) equal native macOS on BOTH drivers, keeping docs/parity-id-policy.md rule 2 at full strength.

BF16 decode improved 2.3-2.7x versus the b6d662a8 matrix on both drivers (fork short 11.70 -> 31.86 tok/s, 1K 10.03 -> 23.11); BF16 prefill improved 2-59%; Q4 legs moved within +/-1% of the previous medians.

The fork Q4 prefill bimodality recorded on 2026-09-10 did not appear this session: all 12 fork reps sat in the fast mode (long-leg min 922.5 tok/s versus 761.6 last session); digests identical throughout, as before.
Fork BF16 decode and stock BF16 decode remain within ~1% of each other (shared decode path); Q4 decode fork leads stock by +9.5/+33.2/+82.5% (short/long/1K).
